message: Download started; steps: manual, fred, ecb, snb, worldbank, defillama, yields, protocols, coingecko, chf_onchain, chf24; CoinGecko key: yes
Manual inputs: figures from reports and web pages
SNB data portal: Swiss money, SARON and exchange rates
World Bank: GDP of the euro area and Switzerland
DefiLlama: total stablecoin supply history, by currency (USD)
DefiLlama: supply history of the 10 largest blockchains
DefiLlama: history of each of the 453 stablecoins (takes several minutes)
NOTE: per-coin supplies are in each coin's own currency (CHF coins in CHF, euro coins in EUR).
history of 2440 pools with at least USD 1 m (10-30 minutes)
DefiLlama: collateral (TVL) history of Frankencoin and HLiquity
CoinGecko: Bitcoin, Ether, USDT and USDC, daily history in USD
CoinGecko: the 100 largest crypto-assets (one history call each, several minutes)
CoinGecko: Swiss franc coins, daily history in CHF, and their blockchains
NOTE: the free API returns at most 365 days of daily history.
On-chain: CHFAU total supply (Ethereum, Base, Polygon)
On-chain: CHF24 (Fiat24) supply on Arbitrum and Mantle
